decisions.reason: The cleaning soap is a cheap complement that supports the core flooring line, and nothing in its results so far justifies giving up the option.
The maintenance oil line is integral to the oiled-surface offer and costs little to keep listed, so keeping the option open remains sensible.
Care products for oiled floors carry low holding costs and support customer relationships, and no evidence yet indicates their value will not be realized.
The moisture-protection underlay is a functional accessory installers need, and its low carrying cost justifies continuing to learn about demand.
The high-density foam underlay may overlap with other underlays, but two years of presence without negative signals do not yet warrant abandonment.
The oak parquet line is at the core of the firm's business, so further commitment is far more likely than abandonment.
